mathematics.assertion_tested: The exact quadratic-form signatures give the three proposed complete fixed-trace laws for symmetric, antisymmetric, and generic bilinear Fourier tensor seeds
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact integers, F_3 and complex cyclotomic rational moments, allowing nonreal finite-size mixed moments; no floating approximation
mathematics.conventions: Seed size b, N=p^(bd), S_xy=N^(-1/2) omega^(x^T (I_d tensor A)y); quadratic signature P_sigma tensor A+P_sigma^T tensor A^T

bounds.zero_signature_counts: p=3, b=2; all three seed types; all partition pairs of L=0..6
bounds.physical_phase_moments: p=3,d=1; symmetric/antisymmetric/generic b=2 seeds and one generic b=3 seed; trace powers at most three
bounds.negative_control: The symmetric seed must have B norm one and must not be certified admissible

non_claims: No universal theorem for arbitrary flat unitary matrices
